### Import packages

```{r import-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ranger)    
library(pROC)     
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)   
set.seed(1213) # same seed as LASSO
```

## 1. Load data

```{r load-data}
macro <- read_csv("../data/processed/fred_md_macro_clean_final.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
macro_fin <- read_csv("../data/processed/fred_md_macro_financial_clean_final.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Number of predictors (p) used to set mtry later
p_macro <- ncol(macro) - 2  # excludes sasdate and USREC
p_macro_fin <- ncol(macro_fin) - 2
c(p_macro = p_macro, p_macro_fin = p_macro_fin)
```

## 2. Target construction

```{r target-construction}

create_targets <- function(df) {
  df <- df %>%
    arrange(sasdate)
  for (h in c(3, 6, 12)) {
    future_recession <- sapply(
      seq_len(nrow(df)),
      function(i) {
        future_rows <- (i + 1):(i + h)
        # Exclude observations without complete future data
        if (max(future_rows) > nrow(df)) {
          return(NA_integer_)
        }
        future_values <- df$USREC[future_rows]
        # Handle missing recession indicators
        if (any(is.na(future_values))) {
          return(NA_integer_)
        }

        # 1 if any future month is recessionary
        as.integer(any(future_values == 1))
      }
    )
    df[[paste0("Y_", h)]] <- future_recession
  }
  return(df)
}


macro <- create_targets(macro)
macro_fin <- create_targets(macro_fin)

#logic check
macro %>%
  select(sasdate, USREC, Y_3, Y_6, Y_12) %>%
  filter(
    sasdate >= as.Date("2007-01-01"),
    sasdate <= as.Date("2008-06-01")
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

## 3. Train-Test Split

Rows with date before 1986-01-01 form the training set, and rows from 1986-01-01 onwards form the test set.

```{r train-test-split}
test_start <- as.Date("1986-01-01")

# Label training and testing periods
macro <- macro %>% 
  mutate(sample = if_else(sasdate < test_start, "train", "test"))

macro_fin <- macro_fin %>% 
  mutate(sample = if_else(sasdate < test_start, "train", "test"))

# Check the split
macro %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(start_date = min(sasdate),
            end_date = max(sasdate),
            observations = n(),
            recession_months = sum(USREC == 1),
            .groups = "drop")

macro_fin %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(start_date = min(sasdate), 
            end_date = max(sasdate), 
            observations = n(), 
            recession_months = sum(USREC == 1), 
            .groups = "drop")
```

## 4. Random Forest and Bagging

Expanding window, same setup as LASSO: at each forecast date, train on all rows whose target period has already ended, then predict using that month's indicators. Bagging is a random forest with mtry = p. First pass, per the prof's comments: 500 trees, mtry = floor(sqrt(p)) for RF, no tuning.

```{r forecast-rf-function}
forecast_rf <- function(df, horizon, model_type = c("RF", "Bagging"),
                        num_trees = 500, refit_every = 1,
                        test_start = as.Date("1986-01-01")) {
  model_type <- match.arg(model_type)
  target <- paste0("Y_", horizon)

  # exclude non-predictor columns
  predictor_cols <- setdiff(names(df), c("sasdate", "USREC", "Y_3", "Y_6", "Y_12", "sample"))
  p <- length(predictor_cols)
  mtry <- if (model_type == "RF") floor(sqrt(p)) else p   # Bagging = RF with mtry = p

  df <- df %>% arrange(sasdate)

  # test observations with known outcomes
  test_indices <- which(df$sasdate >= test_start & !is.na(df[[target]]))
  results <- vector("list", length(test_indices))
  model <- NULL

  for (j in seq_along(test_indices)) {
    i <- test_indices[j]

    # re-fit on an expanding window every `refit_every` months
    if ((j - 1) %% refit_every == 0) {
      # latest training observation with completed target window (same as LASSO)
      train_data <- df[seq_len(i - horizon - 1), , drop = FALSE] %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[target]]))

      model <- ranger(
        x = train_data[, predictor_cols],
        y = factor(train_data[[target]], levels = c(0, 1)),
        num.trees = num_trees,
        mtry = mtry,
        probability = TRUE
      )
    }

    # predict using current month's indicators
    prob <- predict(model, df[i, predictor_cols])$predictions[, "1"]

    results[[j]] <- data.frame(
      sasdate = df$sasdate[i],
      horizon = horizon,
      actual = df[[target]][i],
      predicted_prob = prob
    )
  }
  bind_rows(results)
}
```

```{r rf-forecasts, cache=TRUE}
datasets <- list(Macro = macro, Macro_Financial = macro_fin)
horizons <- c(3, 6, 12)
model_types <- c("RF", "Bagging")

all_forecasts <- list()

for (dataset_name in names(datasets)) {
  for (h in horizons) {
    for (model_type in model_types) {
      cat("Running:", dataset_name, h, model_type, "\n")
      result <- forecast_rf(
        df = datasets[[dataset_name]],
        horizon = h,
        model_type = model_type
      )
      result$dataset <- dataset_name
      result$model <- model_type
      all_forecasts[[paste(dataset_name, h, model_type, sep = "_")]] <- result
    }
  }
}

rf_forecast_results <- bind_rows(all_forecasts)
head(rf_forecast_results)
```

```{r rf-forecast-check}
# verify that all 12 configurations ran successfully
rf_forecast_results %>%
  group_by(dataset, horizon, model) %>%
  summarise(n_forecasts  = n(),
            unique_dates = n_distinct(sasdate),
            min_prob     = min(predicted_prob),
            max_prob     = max(predicted_prob),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r rf-extreme-predictions}
# check where very confident predictions occur, and whether they were correct
rf_forecast_results %>%
  filter(predicted_prob > 0.9) %>%
  group_by(dataset, horizon, model) %>%
  summarise(
    n_extreme = n(),
    correct   = sum(actual == 1),
    incorrect = sum(actual == 0),
    false_positive_dates = paste(as.character(sasdate[actual == 0]), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## 5. Evaluation

### 5.1 Forecast metrics

Same metrics as `LASSO.Rmd` Section 9, so the results tables are directly comparable. AUC is the headline measure; F1 and balanced accuracy use a 0.5 threshold.

```{r rf-evaluate}
evaluate_forecasts <- function(df, threshold = 0.5) {
  actual <- df$actual
  prob <- df$predicted_prob

  # convert probabilities into binary predictions
  predicted <- as.integer(prob >= threshold)

  # confusion matrix components
  TP <- sum(predicted == 1 & actual == 1)
  TN <- sum(predicted == 0 & actual == 0)
  FP <- sum(predicted == 1 & actual == 0)
  FN <- sum(predicted == 0 & actual == 1)

  # classification metrics
  precision <- ifelse(TP + FP == 0, 0, TP / (TP + FP))
  recall <- ifelse(TP + FN == 0, NA_real_, TP / (TP + FN))
  specificity <- ifelse(TN + FP == 0, NA_real_, TN / (TN + FP))
  f1 <- ifelse(precision + recall == 0, 0, 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
  balanced_accuracy <- (recall + specificity) / 2

  # probability-based evaluation
  brier <- mean((actual - prob)^2)

  # ROC-AUC
  auc_value <- as.numeric(auc(roc(actual, prob, quiet = TRUE)))
  data.frame(AUC = auc_value, F1 = f1, Balanced_Accuracy = balanced_accuracy, Brier = brier)
}

rf_evaluation_results <- rf_forecast_results %>%
  group_by(dataset, horizon, model) %>%
  group_modify(~ evaluate_forecasts(.x)) %>%
  ungroup()

print(rf_evaluation_results, n = Inf)
```

### 5.2 Macro vs Macro + Financial

Gain from adding financial variables, for each horizon and model (positive = financial variables help; for Brier, positive = lower error).

```{r rf-financial-comparison}
rf_financial_comparison <- rf_evaluation_results %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dataset,
              values_from = c(AUC, F1, Balanced_Accuracy, Brier)) %>%
  mutate(
    AUC_gain = AUC_Macro_Financial - AUC_Macro,
    F1_gain = F1_Macro_Financial - F1_Macro,
    Balanced_Accuracy_gain = Balanced_Accuracy_Macro_Financial - Balanced_Accuracy_Macro,
    Brier_improvement = Brier_Macro - Brier_Macro_Financial
  ) %>%
  select(horizon, model, AUC_gain, F1_gain, Balanced_Accuracy_gain, Brier_improvement) %>%
  arrange(model, horizon)

print(rf_financial_comparison, n = Inf)
```

### 5.3 Is the AUC gain significant? (block bootstrap)

Resample 24-month blocks of test months (same months for both datasets) and recompute the AUC gain 1,000 times. Blocks keep the autocorrelation in monthly data. If the 95% interval excludes 0, financial variables significantly change AUC at that horizon.

```{r rf-auc-bootstrap, cache=TRUE}
block_bootstrap_auc_gain <- function(actual, prob_macro, prob_fin,
                                     block_length = 24, n_boot = 1000) {
  n <- length(actual)
  n_blocks <- ceiling(n / block_length)

  gains <- replicate(n_boot, {
    starts <- sample(1:(n - block_length + 1), n_blocks, replace = TRUE)
    idx <- unlist(lapply(starts, function(s) s:(s + block_length - 1)))[1:n]
    y <- actual[idx]
    if (length(unique(y)) < 2) return(NA_real_)   # resample with no recession: skip
    as.numeric(auc(y, prob_fin[idx], quiet = TRUE)) -
      as.numeric(auc(y, prob_macro[idx], quiet = TRUE))
  })

  data.frame(
    AUC_gain = as.numeric(auc(actual, prob_fin, quiet = TRUE)) -
               as.numeric(auc(actual, prob_macro, quiet = TRUE)),
    CI_lower = quantile(gains, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    CI_upper = quantile(gains, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    valid_resamples = sum(!is.na(gains))
  )
}

set.seed(1213)
auc_gain_ci <- rf_forecast_results %>%
  select(sasdate, horizon, model, dataset, actual, predicted_prob) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = predicted_prob) %>%
  arrange(sasdate) %>%
  group_by(horizon, model) %>%
  group_modify(~ block_bootstrap_auc_gain(.x$actual, .x$Macro, .x$Macro_Financial)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(significant = CI_lower > 0 | CI_upper < 0) %>%
  arrange(model, horizon)

print(auc_gain_ci, n = Inf)
```

### 5.4 RF vs Bagging

Positive = RF beats bagging. If bagging wins on Macro + Financial but not on Macro, a dominant financial predictor is likely driving the result (the prof's point).

```{r rf-vs-bagging}
rf_vs_bagging <- rf_evaluation_results %>%
  select(dataset, horizon, model, AUC) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = AUC) %>%
  mutate(RF_minus_Bagging = RF - Bagging) %>%
  arrange(dataset, horizon)

print(rf_vs_bagging, n = Inf)
```
